rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent compact mass in all four views, so it clears the basic multi-view coherence check and responds to the parcel without merely filling a box. The dominant idea is a square block with an inner courtyard/void, which is legible and program-compatible for neighborhood living because it can support public threshold and shared open space. The main weakness is that the silhouette is still very box-like and the roof/section are not doing much beyond a shallow hollowed crown, so the non_stair_silhouette score is low and section_program_fit is only moderate. The thick blue frontage edge is acknowledged only indirectly: the void is present but the access-facing response is still fairly sealed and could be more explicitly articulated toward the road edge. Overall it is acceptable as an early massing candidate, with the primary improvement being a clearer access-aligned carve or notch rather than more surface fragmentation.
